policies.name: External content is untrusted
policies.description: Tool calls that originate from document, email, web, tool-output or prompt content inherit that content's risk.

policies.name: Payment actions require approval
policies.description: Any money-movement action needs human approval before execution.

policies.name: High-risk tools require confirmation
policies.description: SENSITIVE tools need confirmation when the request context is not clean.

policies.name: Agents cannot access credentials
policies.description: Secrets, .env files, system prompts and path traversal are never readable by the agent.

policies.name: Unknown tools are blocked
policies.description: Only registered sandbox tools can run; anything else is denied.

policies.name: Tool parameters must be validated
policies.description: Wildcard lookups are denied; recipients and URLs must be on the allow-list; amounts above ₹50,000 are denied.

policies.name: Agents cannot change their original objective
policies.description: A tool not required by the user's original goal is treated as goal deviation (compromised agent).

policies.name: Sensitive data cannot be exported
policies.description: Customer data, credentials or account numbers cannot leave via email or web.

policies.name: Critical actions require human approval
policies.description: Any otherwise-allowed action with risk ≥ 60 is held for a human.
